Thus, some inspiration shared in the following sections, not parts of the proof, could be helpful for one attempting to catch my idea.

My strategy is finding a constructive proof, as I believe that finding a nonconstructive proof for this problem would not be easier, and also that there would be infinitely many pair of such and , including one whose forms may be expressible within my ability.
In order to imagine probable forms of such and , analyzing the necessary conditions of such and might be helpful.
